name: Komine Akihiro
source:
Sachi’s uncle [spoiler] and her guardian. He took charge of raising Sachi after her father died and her mother hospitalized in a traffic accident. He and his wife love Sachi as their own child.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://vnsharing.net/forum/showthread.php?t=302644/]Shiori-chan's review[/url].]
